moments.action: The American calls out across the floor. The woman glances back over her shoulder, then the spiky-haired man breaks away from her and pushes through the crowd toward him.

moments.action: Long take in the lift: the two stand side by side against the green wall in silence, arms folded, until the friend turns to look at him. The last shot is a garage level of cars and people sliding past the opening.

moments.action: The yellow and blue cars drift in tandem past the pillars and the lined-up crowd; the American turns to follow them, staring open-mouthed, his friend coming up behind him.
